name: sluice-board
description: sluice's queue inside a Claude Code session: a band above the prompt, a /sluice pane, a status line, and a turn that delivers an idle session its submission's outcome.

wake.title: Wake on an outcome
wake.description: Collect this session's pending outcomes from sluice, and start a turn with sluice's words.

forecast.title: Wake on a forecast conflict
forecast.description: Forecast this session's work when its branch or the queue moves, and start a turn when it comes to conflict or the conflict clears. SLUICE_FORECAST=0 turns it off too.
